**Exploring memo payload computing**

I'm considering how to identify the memo payload in computing services using RebuildMemoPayload. I think I need to search through the calls and code to understand it better. There seems to be some complexity involved, but I'm curious to see what I can find. My goal will be to clarify how this function works and how it fits into the overall service architecture. Let’s dive into the details!

h14.

`memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`; triggered by `CreateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108`), `UpdateMemo` when `content` is in the update mask (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:435`, `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447`), and the payload-rebuild runner (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:52`); extracts tags plus payload properties: first H1 title, link/code/task-list presence, and incomplete-task presence (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:355`).
